start_model.note: adopted d16384 pair; the stopped cycle-5 candidate is not used

b2b.note: share of sampled sequences, not of loss or gradient; fixed for this first trial

evaluation.positions_note: existing TRAIN cases (known through the old rehearsal data); reported as transfer of the new B2B demonstrations, not as unseen hands
evaluation.landing: own-turn B2B route as in experiments/b2b-zaren-ownturn-check-20261109 (Trackmaker + Ash -> Zaren; Zaren + Cue -> B2B; set Synchro) applied to each case plan
evaluation.if_landing_fails: record it before training and before any comparison result is seen, and revise the plan; no replacement by convenient hands
evaluation.comparison: own turn replayed from the landing record (teacher-forced model history); turn 2 opponent = O1 (Rukina search), common fallback = adopted model; our side = model before (adopted) / after (candidate) from turn 2; stop when turn 4 begins; T1/T2/T3 recorded

engine_run_cap.plan: landing record+replay 2x2=4, before record+replay 2x2=4, after record+replay 2x2=4

retention.baseline: existing adopted-model result (production root opening-baseline.json) if weights, cases, evaluation code and adapters match; otherwise re-register before any extra run

rules: no change during training (ratio, lambda, data)
no extra training, demo generation or ratio change after the result
no adoption, no normal battles, no production change; STOP/pending/cycle-5 candidate unchanged
B2B (3) never described as negating the search
